findings.title: Datavane is a competing platform under the signed CloudSpan exclusivity, in India and the GCC
findings.quote: Datavane appoints Partner, and Partner accepts appointment, as a non-exclusive "Datavane Premier Implementation Partner" for the Territory.
findings.explanation: CloudSpan clause 7.1 says that during its Term AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC, and defines that as any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service. Datavane describes itself as exactly that (a lakehouse and unified analytics platform on subscription), and this draft appoints AtliQ as its implementation partner and pays a referral fee for the Territory, which covers India, all six GCC states and Europe (§1.10). The overlap is India and the GCC, which includes the 'Middle East' pipeline Bhavin mentions; Europe is outside CloudSpan's clause 7. CloudSpan runs to 31 Aug 2028 unless either side gives 90 days' notice, so the two would overlap for at least that period. The carve-out in CloudSpan 7.3(b) does not help because AtliQ would hold a partner appointment with Datavane. Possible conflict, for counsel.

findings.title: 24-month ban on any other-platform work for any 'Datavane Account', which can include AtliQ's existing clients and AtliQ Inc
findings.quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.
findings.explanation: A 'Prospect' is anyone AtliQ engages in 'any discussion regarding the Platform', including an existing AtliQ client (§1.4), and every Prospect becomes a Datavane Account (§1.5, §5.2). So a client AtliQ merely discusses Datavane with could not be served on any other data platform during the Term and for 24 months after, even if Datavane ends the deal on 15 days' notice (§7.2). The restraint names Affiliates (§5.3, §2.4); on the fact sheet AtliQ Inc is 100% owned by the Pvt Ltd, so it appears to be an Affiliate, although only the Pvt Ltd signs. Liability under Section 5 is expressly uncapped (§12.3) and Datavane can end the deal at once for a breach (§7.4) and seek an injunction (§13.3). The same list would also bar CloudSpan work for a Datavane Account. The scope is wide and unclear, so this is a possible conflict, for counsel.

findings.title: Uncapped one-way indemnity for anything 'relating to' AtliQ's services, against a USD 10,000 cap for Datavane
findings.quote: Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services;
findings.explanation: AtliQ covers any and all Losses 'arising out of or relating to' its services, claims by a Datavane Account about any Joint Deal, and acts of its staff or subcontractors, with no limit (§11.1, §12.3). The text does not carve out Losses caused by Datavane's own platform or negligence, so it can be read as covering them; Datavane's indemnity is only for US patent or copyright claims about the Platform, and its total liability is USD 10,000 (§12.2). Karandeep's checklist is indemnity mutual, 'we don't cover their mistakes', and liability at 1x fees, not unlimited. No fee amount is stated in the draft, so the size of the exposure cannot be set against any fee.

findings.title: Datavane can end the deal on 15 days' notice; AtliQ cannot end it for convenience for three years
findings.quote: Partner acknowledges the investment made by Datavane in enabling Partner and agrees that Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term.
findings.explanation: Datavane may terminate for any reason on 15 days' written notice (§7.2); AtliQ has no convenience right for the three-year initial term (§7.3), and the agreement then renews for one-year periods unless Datavane gives notice (§7.1). On expiry or termination no revenue share is payable on any deal not fully paid by the customer (§7.5(c)), while the 24-month restraint in §5.3 survives. The CloudSpan agreement has mutual 90-day termination for convenience, which Karandeep specifically asked for.

findings.title: AtliQ keeps 20% of its own services fees, paid up to about five months after the customer pays
findings.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.
findings.explanation: Joint Deal Revenue includes AtliQ's own implementation fees (§1.7); Datavane invoices the customer and keeps 80% (§6.1, §6.2). AtliQ is paid only after Datavane is paid, within 60 days after the end of that calendar quarter: a customer paying on the first day of a quarter would mean about 90 + 60 = 150 days before AtliQ's share arrives. Checklist: payment 30 days, 45 max. At CloudSpan AtliQ is paid a 12% referral fee on a quarterly statement within 30 days of invoice and contracts directly with the customer for implementation. Whether the economics work is a commercial decision; the draft states no fee amount.

findings.title: Delaware law, San Francisco courts only, and an injunction right that only Datavane has
findings.quote: Any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the City and County of San Francisco, California, and each Party irrevocably submits to the personal jurisdiction of such courts and waives any objection based on inconvenient forum.
findings.explanation: The checklist position for the Pvt Ltd is Indian law. This draft is Delaware law with exclusive San Francisco courts, and only Datavane may seek an injunction (§13.3) for Sections 5, 8 or 9. AtliQ has accepted a non-Indian law for a partner before (Singapore law and SIAC arbitration at CloudSpan, recorded as accepted).
